name: 2026 Workshop of the Australasian Macroeconomics Society (WAMS 2026, Tokyo Edition)
organizer: Australasian Macroeconomics Society (AMS); hosted by the University of Tokyo
conf_dates_note: Econometric Society announcement says "November 20th & 22nd 2026"; WAMS site says November 20-22, 2026.
deadline_note: Closed. Stated as "The submission deadline is the 31st of August, 2026."
submission_requirements: Full papers in any area related to macroeconomics (theoretical, empirical or policy-oriented) via the online form (Google account login). Workshop registration required (submission page gives 4 October 2026; registration page says open until 11 October, 5 pm AEST).
